---
title: "Overall survival censoring scenarios — results"
subtitle: "Unadjusted survival curves and treatment hazard ratios"
format: html
---

- Scenarios for survival outcomes, not bounds on the treatment hazard ratio.
- Credible intervals are conditional on each assumed endpoint.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggdist)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

scenario_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "06-censoring", "results", "scenarios"
)
draw_dir <- file.path(scenario_dir, "posterior-draws")
figure_dir <- file.path(scenario_dir, "figures")
dir.create(draw_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

n_draws <- 1000L
scenario_names <- c("best-case", "worst-case")
scenario_labels <- c("Best case", "Worst case")

scenarios <- read_parquet(file.path(scenario_dir, "scenarios.parquet")) |>
  mutate(tx_plot = group_factor(tx))
scenario_counts <- read_parquet(
  file.path(scenario_dir, "scenario-counts.parquet")
)

models <- map(scenario_names, \(scenario_name) {
  readRDS(
    file.path(scenario_dir, "models", paste0(scenario_name, "-model.rds"))
  )
})
```

## Survival curves, hazard ratios and sampling diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: posterior-summaries
#| include: false

curves <- map(seq_along(scenario_names), \(index) {
  scenario_data <- scenarios |>
    filter(scenario == scenario_names[[index]])

  posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
    models[[index]],
    # Treatment is the only predictor, so one row gives the standardized curve.
    data = models[[index]]$data[1L, , drop = FALSE],
    horizon = max(scenario_data$survival_time_days),
    n_points = 200L,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 1500
  ) |>
    mutate(scenario = scenario_names[[index]])
}) |>
  list_rbind()

hr_draws <- map2(models, scenario_names, \(model, scenario_name) {
  coefficient_draws <- as.matrix(model, pars = "tx")

  tibble(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    draw = seq_len(nrow(coefficient_draws)),
    log_hazard_ratio = coefficient_draws[, 1L],
    hazard_ratio = exp(log_hazard_ratio)
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

# R-hat and n_eff come from rstanarm's stored stan_summary.
sampling_summary <- map2(models, scenario_names, \(model, scenario_name) {
  sampler <- rstan::get_sampler_params(model$stanfit, inc_warmup = FALSE)

  tibble(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    participants_fitted = nrow(model$data),
    chains = model$stanfit@sim$chains,
    iterations = model$stanfit@sim$iter,
    warmup = model$stanfit@sim$warmup,
    posterior_draws = nrow(as.matrix(model, pars = "tx")),
    max_rhat = max(model$stan_summary[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess = min(model$stan_summary[, "n_eff"], na.rm = TRUE),
    divergences = sum(map_dbl(sampler, \(x) sum(x[, "divergent__"])))
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

curve_summary <- curves |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower = quantile(survival, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    upper = quantile(survival, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    .by = c(scenario, tx, time)
  )

hr_summary <- hr_draws |>
  summarise(
    median = median(hazard_ratio),
    ci_66_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.17, names = FALSE),
    ci_66_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.83, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_low = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    ci_95_high = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    probability_benefit = mean(hazard_ratio < 1),
    posterior_draws = n(),
    .by = scenario
  )

write_parquet(
  curves,
  file.path(draw_dir, "scenario-curves.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  hr_draws,
  file.path(draw_dir, "scenario-hazard-ratios.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  curve_summary,
  file.path(scenario_dir, "scenario-survival-curve-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  hr_summary,
  file.path(scenario_dir, "scenario-hazard-ratio-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  sampling_summary,
  file.path(scenario_dir, "scenario-sampling-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| label: build-plots
#| include: false

max_follow_up <- max(scenarios$survival_time_days)

survival_plots <- map(seq_along(scenario_names), \(index) {
  scenario_data <- scenarios |>
    filter(scenario == scenario_names[[index]])
  plot_curves <- curve_summary |>
    filter(scenario == scenario_names[[index]])

  km_fit <- survfit2(
    Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~ tx_plot,
    data = scenario_data,
    conf.type = "log-log"
  )

  survival_plot <- plot_km_model(km_fit, plot_curves, x_max = max_follow_up)

  save_figure(
    ggsurvfit_build(survival_plot),
    file.path(figure_dir, paste0(scenario_names[[index]], "-survival.png")),
    height = 6.5
  )

  survival_plot
})

hr_plot <- hr_draws |>
  transmute(
    draw = hazard_ratio,
    panel = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_names, labels = scenario_labels)
  ) |>
  plot_posterior(
    x_label = "Unadjusted hazard ratio, ctDNA versus usual care",
    reference = 1,
    log_scale = TRUE
  )

save_figure(
  hr_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "scenario-hazard-ratio.png"),
  height = 6
)
```
